7 انصاع : see 5. ―
-b2- Also (tropical:) He turned away, or back, retreating, or returning, (S, O, K, TA,) and went (S, TA) quickly, or hastening: (S, O, K, TA:) or you say, انصاع القَوْمُ (tropical:) The people, or party, went away quickly: and مُدْبِرًا (tropical:) He went away [turning back] quickly. (TA.) [See an ex. voce صَارَّةٌ.] ―
-b3- And (assumed tropical:) It (a bird) ascended, or mounted, into the air, between the earth and sky, or into the middle of the sky. (TA in art. صيع, from the book entitled “ Ghareeb el- Hamám ” by El-Hasan Ibn-' Abd-Alláh El-Kátib El-Isbahánee.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
